name: Saint Barbara
contribution: An early Christian and martyr of Phoenician origin from Heliopolis.

checks.lead: Saint Barbara (Ancient Greek: Ἁγία Βαρβάρα; Coptic: Ϯⲁⲅⲓⲁ Ⲃⲁⲣⲃⲁⲣⲁ; Church Slavonic: Великомученица Варва́ра Илиопольская; Arabic: القديسة الشهيدة بربارة), known in the Eastern Orthodox Church as the Great Martyr Barbara, was an early Christian and martyr of Phoenician origin from Heliopolis (modern-day Baalbek, Lebanon).
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
